rv.q: But anyone with a deep affection for the theater won’t want to miss these rare birds bantering.
Few stars can make a banquet out of table scraps as Ms. Lansbury does.
In spite of its title, there's really not much Broadway and surprisingly even less Christmas material in their show, but for sure there's plenty of Donny and Marie.
Although the drama doesn’t serve the stars well and fails as drama, you certainly can’t fault the ladies, who deliver well placed aces.
